title: BAT-FAM
description: Follow Batman, Alfred, and young Damian Wayne—who has taken on the mantle of Little Batman—alongside a few newcomers to Wayne Manor, as they navigate the fun and frustrations of life as a super family

episodes.title: S1-E4All in a Bat's Day's Work

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Bruce's plans of having the perfect family-game-night unravel when Damian and Claire become suspicious of their newest family member.

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Damian and the Dent twins accidentally unleash parademons when they try to shake their chaperone, Bruce Wayne, on a class field trip to Star-Labs.

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Trouble finds Little Batman when he ignores his dad's advice and coerces Afred to become Exo-Bat to help him take down the Mad Hatter.

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The Bat-Fam stumbles upon a sinister caper that involves Wayne Enterprises on "Go to Work With a Grown-Up Day".

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Bruce decides it's time to let Alicia in on his "little secret"- that he's Batman. However, Alicia has a little secret of her own.

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: When an old pal/fellow ex-criminal makes Claire an irresistible offer, she finds herself having to choose between her new life and her old one.

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: After Bruce tells Damian that a crime spree of stolen Goki Cards isn't a big enough caper for the Batmen, Damian teams up with Dr. Langstrom.

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Bruce becomes his own worst enemy when he tries to keep E*Vil out of his tightly planned family interview with Vicky Vale.

episodes_data.title: BAT-FAM Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: As a dark plot unfolds, it will take every member of the Bat-Fam working together to save Gotham and its citizens.
